explicit_nonclaims: ASR is probabilistic and is not human-certified pronunciation evidence.
Fine pronunciation, perceived accent, prosody, reductions and stress are not certified.
Requested en-US accent is not treated as perceptually verified.

practice_target_decision.rationale: The speech target requires ordinary aural form recognition of room identifier and time/day information. It does not require fine phonetic, accent, prosodic or contrastive-acoustic certification. Exact canonical/segment binding plus deterministic asset integrity and unprompted ASR lexical support are sufficient for controlled low-stakes Practice use under the current internal release policy.

evidence_semantics.first_pass: Independent, replay_count=0, NORMAL playback gives strongest item-level evidence.
evidence_semantics.slow_playback: Assisted evidence; not equivalent to normal-speed first pass.
evidence_semantics.mastery_limit: One correct answer does not imply generalized mastery or TRANSFER_SUPPORTED.

historical_next_action.requires: Controlled import; support/rights checks; desktop/mobile live verification; exact-realization audio-feedback write/read verification; AI-generated disclosure; rollback. No Owner action required.
